title: MCP tools: timeline_copy_frames and timeline_paste_frames
description:
Add two new MCP tools to expose the existing core timeline copy/paste frame operations:
1. timeline_copy_frames: calls the JSFL timeline.copyFrames() path (core copyFramesDoc). Params: startFrame?, endFrame?, layerIndex?.
2. timeline_paste_frames: calls timeline.pasteFrames() (core pasteFramesDoc). Params: frameIndex?, replaceFrames?.
Add schemas to packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts, handler to packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts, and MCP tool description to packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts.
Look at how other timeline_* tools like timeline_insert_keyframe are structured as the template.
